The three filters with counts work well, and the per-item toggle is enough. I’d keep changing the state manual—opening a link doesn’t necessarily mean I finished reading it, so it should not automatically become read.

I wouldn’t put every newly saved link in “To read,” though. Some links are references I’ve already read and simply want to keep. In the review step, give me a “Read later” choice. If I select it, the bookmark starts in To read; otherwise it remains an ordinary read/saved bookmark. On an ordinary item, the action should say something like “Read later,” while an unread item should offer “Mark as read.”
